items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I recently I was able to do an interview with a drummer named Ed Soph who was one of those guys who played with everybody but also a legend in the jazz education world.
